d: We are looking for an analytical, solution-oriented, and results-driven Business Process Consultant to assess, optimize, and transform business processes across the organization.

The role will be responsible for evaluating existing business workflows, identifying operational inefficiencies, developing process improvement solutions, and supporting the implementation of standardized and efficient business practices.

The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to simplify processes, enhance productivity, strengthen internal controls, and align business operations with organizational objectives.
Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and operational procedures to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
Conduct process assessments, gap analysis, and root cause analysis across various business functions.
Develop and document business process maps, workflows, SOPs, policies, and process guidelines.
Design and recommend process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, productivity, and service delivery.
Lead business process reengineering (BPR) and continuous improvement projects.
Collaborate with Finance, HR, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, and IT teams to understand business requirements and operational challenges.
Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardization, automation, and digital transformation.
Evaluate existing internal controls and recommend improvements to strengthen process governance and compliance.
Facilitate workshops and stakeholder discussions to gather requirements and develop practical business solutions.
Translate business requirements into functional specifications and coordinate with IT teams for system and process enhancements.
Develop process performance indicators (KPIs) to measure efficiency, effectiveness, and improvement outcomes.
Support the implementation of new processes, ensuring stakeholder alignment, training, and effective change management.
Monitor implemented solutions and evaluate their impact on operational performance and business outcomes.
Prepare process assessment reports, recommendations, and management presentations for senior leadership.
Maintain process documentation and ensure regular reviews and updates in line with organizational requirements.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
MBA or professional certification in Business Process Management, Lean Six Sigma, or Project Management will be an advantage.
4–7 years of relevant experience in business process consulting, process improvement, business transformation, or operational excellence.
Strong understanding of business process management (BPM), process mapping, workflow design, and process reengineering.
Hands-on experience with process documentation tools and methodologies.
Knowledge of Lean Management, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and continuous improvement frameworks will be preferred.
Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics will be an advantage.
Proficiency in MS Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, and process mapping tools.
Knowledge of Power BI and workflow automation platforms will be preferred.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

q: 8 to 12 years in IT, with at least 3 years leading IT for a site or company.

Oracle ERP (EBS or Fusion) support, user access and vendor coordination through a migration.

Grow with Agthia – For the Better

Agthia Group is one of the region’s leading Food & Beverage companies, with a growing international footprint. We are a publicly listed company on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) and part of ADQ, one of region’s largest holding companies.

Rooted in Abu Dhabi since 1978, we've grown into a global presence, operating in countries including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, Turkey, and Jordan. We’ve built a diverse portfolio of over 35 market-leading brands across Water & Food, Snacking, Protein & Frozen, and Agri-Business – touching the lives of millions of consumers in more than 65 global markets. With sustainability at the core of our innovations, we’ve pioneered several world-first products, setting new benchmarks in industry and meeting the evolving needs of communities worldwide.

Over 12,000 people from more than 67 nationalities are at the heart of shaping our purpose driven future, supported by an agile environment which encourages collaboration, creativity, and the freedom to make a real difference. With a competitive benefits package, genuine opportunities to advance, and a focus on continuous learning and development, we’re committed to supporting your growth as we work together to deliver excellence “For the Better.”
Join us and be part of a team that's not just shaping the future of food and beverage but also making a meaningful impact on the world. Together, let's grow 'For the Better.'
r: To lead and manage day-to-day IT operations across Al Faysal and Al Rammah in Kuwait, covering IT infrastructure, systems, vendors and service delivery. The role will also coordinate key IT projects, including the Al Faysal migration to Oracle ERP and the transition to a Group Managed Service Provider (MSP) model. This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical and operational expertise.
How Will You Make an Impact?
Own day-to-day IT operations across all Kuwait sites and act as the single IT point of contact for the business.
Ensure all incidents, service requests and changes are logged and managed through the ITSM tool (ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus).
Provide hands-on support for end-user, infrastructure and application issues; escalate to group D&T, the MSP or vendors where required.
Track SLAs and follow the group service management and change processes.
Manage firewalls (FortiGate), site-to-site VPN, switching, routing and Wi-Fi across sites.
Administer Windows Server, Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
Administer Microsoft 365 services (Exchange Online, Teams, Intune).
Run IT asset management, backups and basic cybersecurity hygiene (patching, access control).
Manage local IT vendors and contracts, including performance, renewals and costs.
Act as the local lead for the future group MSP and support the move from local IT to the MSP model.
Monitor MSP and vendor SLAs, raise breaches and follow up on service improvement actions.
Project Delivery (incl. Al Faisal Oracle Migration)
Lead local delivery of IT projects, including the Al Faisal migration to Oracle ERP.
Coordinate ERP vendors through the migration: requirements, user access, testing, cut-over and post go-live support.
Provide ongoing Oracle ERP support and user access management for Kuwait.
Report IT performance, SLAs, assets, risks and project status to D&T leadership.
Ensure compliance with group IT policies, security controls and approval processes.
Maintain up-to-date IT documentation for Kuwait sites.

d: We believe that managing risks is not just about preventing challenges, it’s about creating opportunities, building resilience, and driving smarter business decisions.

At Boutiqaat, we’re looking for a Risk Management Associate to join our team and help strengthen our Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) practices across our e-commerce, retail, logistics, technology, and corporate functions.
If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, curious about how businesses operate, and ready to turn data into insights, this could be the perfect opportunity to launch your career!
q: A bachelor degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
0–1 year of experience in Risk Management, Internal Audit, Compliance, Internal Control, or a related area. Internships and relevant academic projects are welcome!
A basic understanding of Enterprise Risk Management, risk assessments, internal controls, and risk monitoring.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving.
Good communication, teamwork, organization, and report-writing skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Familiarity with Power BI, ERP/GRC systems, ISO 31000, or relevant risk certifications is a plus.
Fluency in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.
Above all, a proactive mindset, high integrity, and a willingness to learn and grow.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Identify & Assess Risks: Help identify business risks, evaluate controls, and support risk assessments with teams across the organization.
Monitor & Report: Maintain risk registers, track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), follow up on mitigation plans, and help transform risk data into meaningful reports and dashboards.
Build Business Resilience: Support business continuity planning, assessments, and exercises to help keep critical operations running smoothly.
Collaborate & Connect: Work with cross-functional teams to gather information, document controls, and ensure risks are properly monitored and escalated.
Strengthen Governance: Support risk policies, procedures, audit requirements, and risk awareness initiatives while staying informed about emerging business risks.
